intent: Coordinate the multi-repo feature lifecycle from start/status/commit/finish in a consistent, auditable flow.
triggers: start a feature across multiple repositories
prepare cross-repo commits and pull requests

agent_policy.notes: Provider-neutral workflow. Optionally set preferred_agents for local routing if needed.

restore_notes: After finishing the feature, restore pre-branch local state per repository by listing stash entries and applying the matching cpi snapshot.
Recommended: git stash list --date=local | rg cpi-pre-branch-<feature-branch>
Restore without dropping: git stash apply stash@{N}
Restore and remove snapshot: git stash pop stash@{N}
Verify git status, branch, upstream, and ahead/behind after restore.
If a repo had in-progress operations (rebase/cherry-pick/merge), resolve or abort those before restore.

steps.description: Ensure the target path contains at least one git repository.
Load current multi-repo feature context when present.
steps.command: test -f {{repo_path}}/.cursor/.workspace-context.json && cat {{repo_path}}/.cursor/.workspace-context.json || echo "no workspace context file found"

steps.description: Persist structured pre-snapshot git state per repository.
steps.command: feature_branch="{{env}}"; snapshot_dir="{{repo_path}}/.cpi-state/$feature_branch"; mkdir -p "$snapshot_dir"; for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then repo=$(basename "$d"); out="$snapshot_dir/$repo.pre-state.txt"; echo "repo=$repo" > "$out"; echo "path=$d" >> "$out"; echo "feature_branch=$feature_branch" >> "$out"; echo "captured_at=$(date -Is)" >> "$out"; echo "branch=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current)" >> "$out"; echo "upstream=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo none)" >> "$out"; echo "ahead_behind=$(git -C "$d" rev-list --left-right --count @{u}...HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)" >> "$out"; echo "stash_head_before=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --verify -q refs/stash || echo none)" >> "$out"; echo "in_progress_rebase_merge=$([ -d "$d/.git/rebase-merge" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" >> "$out"; echo "in_progress_rebase_apply=$([ -d "$d/.git/rebase-apply" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" >> "$out"; echo "in_progress_merge_head=$([ -f "$d/.git/MERGE_HEAD" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" >> "$out"; echo "in_progress_cherry_pick=$([ -f "$d/.git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)" >> "$out"; echo "--- status_porcelain_v1 ---" >> "$out"; git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v1 >> "$out"; echo "--- status_porcelain_v2_branch ---" >> "$out"; git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v2 --branch >> "$out"; echo "--- submodule_status ---" >> "$out"; git -C "$d" submodule status >> "$out" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "--- worktree_list ---" >> "$out"; git -C "$d" worktree list >> "$out" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; echo "snapshot_dir=$snapshot_dir"

steps.description: Save staged/unstaged/untracked changes before branch orchestration.
steps.command: feature_branch="{{env}}"; snapshot_dir="{{repo_path}}/.cpi-state/$feature_branch"; mkdir -p "$snapshot_dir"; for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then repo=$(basename "$d"); meta="$snapshot_dir/$repo.stash-meta.txt"; before=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --verify -q refs/stash || echo none); if [ -n "$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "== $repo == stashing changes"; git -C "$d" stash push -u -m "cpi-pre-branch-$feature_branch"; after=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --verify -q refs/stash || echo none); echo "repo=$repo" > "$meta"; echo "feature_branch=$feature_branch" >> "$meta"; echo "stash_head_before=$before" >> "$meta"; echo "stash_head_after=$after" >> "$meta"; echo "created_at=$(date -Is)" >> "$meta"; else echo "== $repo == clean"; echo "repo=$repo" > "$meta"; echo "feature_branch=$feature_branch" >> "$meta"; echo "stash_head_before=$before" >> "$meta"; echo "stash_head_after=$before" >> "$meta"; echo "created_at=$(date -Is)" >> "$meta"; echo "stashed=0" >> "$meta"; fi; fi; done; echo "snapshot_dir=$snapshot_dir"

steps.description: Create/check out feature branch from each repo base branch according to workspace conventions.
steps.command: feature_branch="{{env}}"; case "$feature_branch" in local|dry-run|dummy|'') echo "branch creation skipped: provide feature branch name in --env"; exit 0;; esac; for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then repo=$(basename "$d"); base=""; case "$repo" in humand-main-api|humand-web|humand-backoffice|humand-mobile) base="develop";; material-hu|hu-translations) base="main";; *) echo "== $repo == no base mapping"; continue;; esac; current=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current); if [ "$current" = "$feature_branch" ]; then echo "== $repo == already on $feature_branch"; continue; fi; if [ "$current" != "$base" ]; then echo "== $repo == expected base $base but found $current"; continue; fi; echo "== $repo == creating/checking out $feature_branch from $base"; git -C "$d" fetch origin "$base" && git -C "$d" pull origin "$base" && (git -C "$d" checkout -b "$feature_branch" 2>/dev/null || git -C "$d" checkout "$feature_branch"); fi; done

steps.description: Collect branch and dirty-state status for each repository under the workspace root.
steps.command: for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo "== $(basename "$d") =="; git -C "$d" branch --show-current; git -C "$d" status --short; echo; fi; done

steps.description: Identify repositories with local commits ahead of upstream.
steps.command: for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then b=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current); if [ -n "$b" ]; then c=$(git -C "$d" rev-list --count "origin/$b..HEAD" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "$(basename "$d"): ahead_by=$c"; fi; fi; done

steps.description: Run lightweight quality gates where package metadata exists.
steps.command: for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ] && [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then echo "== $(basename "$d") =="; (cd "$d" && (npm run lint --if-present || true) && (npm run type-check --if-present || true) && (npm run build --if-present || true)); fi; done

steps.description: Emit workflow hint for the next lifecycle transition.
steps.command: echo "Lifecycle hint: start -> status -> commit -> finish (env={{env}})"

steps.description: Document how to restore pre-branch local state captured during snapshot_local_changes.
steps.command: feature_branch="{{env}}"; echo "State restore instructions for $feature_branch"; for d in {{repo_path}}/*; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then repo=$(basename "$d"); echo "== $repo =="; git -C "$d" stash list --date=local | rg "cpi-pre-branch-$feature_branch" || echo "no cpi snapshot stash found"; echo "restore: git -C $d stash apply stash@{N}"; echo "restore+drop: git -C $d stash pop stash@{N}"; echo "verify status: git -C $d status --short --branch"; echo "verify upstream: git -C $d rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo no-upstream"; echo "verify submodules: git -C $d submodule status 2>/dev/null || true"; echo "verify worktrees: git -C $d worktree list 2>/dev/null || true"; echo "verify in-progress ops: test -d $d/.git/rebase-merge -o -d $d/.git/rebase-apply -o -f $d/.git/MERGE_HEAD -o -f $d/.git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD && echo in-progress-op || echo clean"; echo; fi; done
